result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a signalized crossing. However, the environment is degraded by faded crosswalk markings, a lack of dedicated pedestrian signals, and wide corner radii that may encourage higher vehicle turning speeds.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the roadway in the foreground and right side of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't-walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle traffic lights which can lead to conflicts with turning traffic.

hazards.name: Wide corner radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry is relatively open, which can facilitate higher-speed right turns by vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: The corner near the red fire hydrant

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Apply thermoplastic high-visibility crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the pedestrian crossing zone.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance for pedestrians and slow down turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and there are no visible traffic control devices such as stop signs or signals at the intersection.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The continental-style crosswalk markings are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and across the side street

hazards.name: Uncontrolled intersection
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible at this four-way intersection, creating potential right-of-way confusion.

hazards.name: Construction equipment near walkway
hazards.description: Orange barrels and barricades are placed near the corner, which may slightly impede pedestrian movement or sightlines.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk repainting
interventions.description: Refresh the crosswalk markings with high-visibility thermoplastic paint to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Intersection traffic control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or other traffic calming measures to clarify right-of-way and manage vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The intersection features a large pedestrian refuge island and signalized crossings, providing some protection for walkers. However, the presence of a channelized slip lane and wide turning radii increases the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflicts.

hazards.name: Slip lane
hazards.description: Channelized right-turn lane allows for high-speed vehicle movements across a pedestrian path.

hazards.name: Wide turning radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry encourages fast turns, increasing risk at conflict points.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install across the slip lane to slow traffic and improve visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Tighten the radii to reduce vehicle speeds and crossing distances.

result.summary: The intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian infrastructure, including marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and continuous sidewalks. The wide roadway and lack of dedicated pedestrian space create a hostile environment for people walking through this signalized junction.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to designate a safe crossing path for pedestrians across any leg of the intersection.

hazards.name: Absence of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection is signalized for vehicles but lacks any walk/don't-walk indicators for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Discontinuous pedestrian path
hazards.description: The paved area on the right corner does not connect to a continuous sidewalk network, leaving pedestrians stranded.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Heads
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps and Sidewalk Extensions
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps and extend sidewalks to provide a continuous, accessible path of travel.
